acceptanceCriteria: Linux process-group retirement for gradle-junit is implemented and qualified on a real Linux host
the off-Darwin refusal is narrowed to unqualified hosts only
spec TRE-V0 records the Linux qualification evidence
body: V1-0622 (TRE-V0-042/043) refuses the gradle-junit runner off Darwin because per-run process-tree retirement is only qualified on macOS. Linux CI and adopters therefore cannot use it.
title: gradle-junit runner: Linux process retirement instead of refusing off Darwin
